question: For each subnet name, show the subnet’s FIRST_IP range and variance across its IP allocation pools (considering only routes whose next hop is 10.30.19.197/8 and only subnets with ID 012993ae-5d73-4aad-834b-e87a31e99d48), along with the average FIRST_IP range across all such subnets. Do not return any rounded answers.

prediction.sql:
WITH inner_cte AS (
  SELECT
    s.name AS subnet_name,
    MAX(p.first_ip) - MIN(p.first_ip) AS first_ip_range,
    VARIANCE(p.first_ip) AS first_ip_variance
  FROM subnets s
  JOIN subnetroutes r ON r.subnet_id = s.id
  JOIN ipallocationpools p ON p.subnet_id = s.id
  WHERE r.nexthop = '10.30.19.197/8'
    AND s.id = '012993ae-5d73-4aad-834b-e87a31e99d48'
  GROUP BY s.name
)
SELECT
  i.subnet_name,
  i.first_ip_range,
  i.first_ip_variance,
  a.avg_first_ip_range
FROM inner_cte i
CROSS JOIN (
  SELECT AVG(first_ip_range) AS avg_first_ip_range
  FROM inner_cte
) a;
